grf-des.js is adapted from src/des.ts in grf-loader 0.0.2:
https://github.com/vthibault/grf-loader
https://github.com/vthibault/grf-loader/blob/master/src/des.ts

The upstream package declares the MIT license in package.json (retained as
grf-loader-package.json). Author: Vincent Thibault.
Local changes: removed TypeScript type annotations and added an attribution
comment. No algorithm changes.
